name: Changelog Manager
author: agolollo

sections.description:
Changelog Manager is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that allows you to create, manage, and display changelogs for your projects. With advanced features like AI Helper, custom themes, email notifications, and detailed statistics.

Key Features:

  • 📝 Easy Changelog Management – Create and organize your software updates
  • 🤖 AI Helper – Get intelligent assistance with changelog creation
  • 📊 Statistics Dashboard – Track your development progress
  • 🎨 Custom Themes – Multiple display themes for your changelogs
  • 📧 Email Notifications – Keep users informed of updates
  • 🗺️ Roadmap Management – Plan and share your development roadmap
  • 📈 Timeline View – Visual timeline of all your releases
  • 🔄 Version Comparison – Compare different versions side by side
  • 📤 CSV Export – Export your data for external analysis
  • ⚙️ Customizable Settings – Full control over appearance and behavior

Support

For support and feature requests, please contact us through our support channel.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/changelog-manager directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Changelog Manager menu item to configure the plugin
  4. Create your first changelog entry to get started
sections.faq:
How do I create a new changelog entry?

Navigate to the Changelog Manager in your WordPress admin, click “Add New” and fill in the version details, features, bugfixes, and improvements.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes! The plugin includes multiple themes and color customization options in the Settings tab.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, Changelog Manager is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme.

Can I export my changelog data?

Yes, you can export all your changelog data as a CSV file from the Timeline tab.
